ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {SUBJECT} for {OTHER_nameDef}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A grown-up fond of one of the colony's children wants a toy made for them at the bench (with Vanilla Christmas Expanded one of its toys, else a small sculpture). Once it is made, they take it to the child themselves.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has been talking to a stick with a face scratched on it for a week. {OTHER_pronoun} deserves a better friend than that stick.
{OTHER_nameDef} plays with whatever the grown-ups throw away, and makes it look like a game. Imagine what {OTHER_pronoun} would do with a real toy.
I caught {OTHER_nameDef} building a little house out of chips from the woodpile, very carefully, and nobody to live in it. Could someone make something to live in it?
[lowtech] When I was small we had carved animals, a whole herd of them, and I was never lonely. {OTHER_nameDef} has none.
[!lowtech] Every child I ever knew had at least one toy worn half to nothing from being loved. {OTHER_nameDef} has nothing to wear out.
[winter] The evenings are long, and {OTHER_nameDef} spends them watching the fire with nothing in {OTHER_possessive} hands.
[trait:Kind] It would cost the bench an afternoon, and {OTHER_nameDef} would carry it everywhere for a year.

warm.li: I'd like something made for {OTHER_nameDef}, something that's {OTHER_possessive} own. I'll carry it over myself.
{OTHER_nameDef} never asks for anything, which is exactly why somebody should ask for {OTHER_objective}.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} needs a toy. Someone at the bench could make one in an afternoon.

cheerful.li: A toy for {OTHER_nameDef}! I've already decided which way I'll hide it behind my back.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is growing up out here with nothing but chores and cold. One toy wouldn't fix that, but it would help.

cold.li: A child with something to play with is quieter and learns faster. A toy for {OTHER_nameDef} is a sensible use of the bench.

plain.li: It's made. I'm taking it to {OTHER_nameDef} myself, and I'd like to see {OTHER_possessive} face.
[promised] The council said it would see to it, and there it is on the bench. Now to find {OTHER_nameDef}.

warm.li: Thank you. I've been looking forward to this more than {OTHER_nameDef} will.

blunt.li: Good. It's done. I'll take it over.

cheerful.li: It's perfect! {OTHER_nameDef} is going to shriek.

gloomy.li: It's a good one. I hope it lasts longer than most things here.

cold.li: The toy is made. I will deliver it.

plain.li: Nobody made anything for {OTHER_nameDef} after all. I suppose the stick will have to do.

warm.li: I'll whittle something myself, badly. {OTHER_nameDef} won't mind.

gloomy.li: Of course. There's never an afternoon for a child here.

cold.li: The bench had other work. I'll remember that.

li.label: a toy of my own
li.description: Someone made a toy just for me, and brought it to me themselves.

li.label: gave a child a toy
li.description: I asked for a toy for a child, and I was the one who handed it over.
